## Upper Arm

The elbow is a hinge joint and thus moves in only one plane (sagittal). The muscles acting at the elbow are heavily involved in multi-joint upper-body exercises such as presses, pull-ups, and rows. However, both the elbow flexors and the elbow extensors contain biarticular (crossing two joints) muscles. The length-tension

a

relationship of these muscles is therefore suboptimal during multi-joint exercises. Accordingly, targeted single-joint exercises afford the potential for stronger muscular contractions and thus greater growth.
